name: DecDCTReset
evidence: Defined as DecDCTReset in mdec_diag/decdct.c (mode 0 calls ResetCallback then MdecDiag_Reset); boot_display image_display.c:48 and menu_memcard video_open.inc:127 still called it by address.

name: MdecDiag_ExpandDecoderTable
evidence: Defined as MdecDiag_ExpandDecoderTable in mdec_diag/vlc_build.c (expands D_8010CBFC into the DecDCTvlc2 table); callers boot_display image_display.c:50, sprites.c:38 and menu_memcard video_open.inc:133 used the address.

name: DecDCTin
evidence: Sets/clears MDEC command bits 27 and 25 from a mode argument then sends the buffer through MdecDiag_SendInput (decdct.c:69); sits between DecDCTPutEnv and DecDCTout in the LIBPRESS DCT object; debug_source.c:210 calls it with (buffer, mode).

name: DecDCTout
evidence: Wrapper over MdecDiag_ReceiveOutput(buffer, size) (decdct.c:85); debug_source.c:215 calls it with a frame buffer and a size.

name: DecDCTinSync
evidence: mode 0 waits through func_8010C308 (the MDEC_in_sync wait), otherwise returns MDEC status bit 29 (command busy); decdct.c:89.

name: DecDCToutSync
evidence: mode 0 waits through func_8010C39C (the MDEC_out_sync wait), otherwise returns bit 24 of the status word; boot_display image_display.c:263 and sprites.c:148 poll it with mode 1.

name: DecDCTinCallback
evidence: DMACallback(0, value): DMA channel 0 is MDEC-in (decdct.c:111); twin of DecDCToutCallback.

name: DecDCToutCallback
evidence: DMACallback(1, value): DMA channel 1 is MDEC-out; include/pe1/psyq_press.h already documents it as DecDCToutCallback.

name: MdecDiag_WaitInputSync
evidence: Busy-waits on the MDEC status register bit 29 and reports the name string D_8010BD18 (MDEC_in_sync) through the timeout handler (mdec_wait.c:8); called by MdecDiag_SendInput and DecDCTinSync.

name: MdecDiag_WaitOutputSync
evidence: Busy-waits on DMA1 CHCR bit 24 and reports D_8010BD28 (MDEC_out_sync) (mdec_wait.c:14); called by MdecDiag_ReceiveOutput and DecDCToutSync.

name: MdecDiag_ReadStatus
evidence: Returns the word at the MDEC status register pointer (mdec_status.c:4); DecDCTinSync/DecDCToutSync test bits of it.

name: MdecDiag_HandleTimeout
evidence: printf("%s timeout:\n", name) then the same MDEC/DMA reset sequence as MdecDiag_Reset case 1 (mdec_status.c:9); called from both wait loops on timeout.

name: DecDCTvlcSize
evidence: LIBPRESS VLC object: 12 of 12 words identical to the PSY-Q 3.5 vlc.o DecDCTvlcSize (configs/USA/original_asm_evidence.json, verified 2026-10-05); the vlc.c header comment already named it.

name: DecDCTvlc
evidence: LIBPRESS VLC object decoder with the frameless static-state protocol of the 3.5 routine (original_asm_evidence.json); vlc.c header comment.

name: DecDCTvlcSize2
evidence: LIBPRESS VLC_C twin of DecDCTvlcSize with its own limit word D_8011EB8C (original_asm_evidence.json); boot_display calls it with the bitstream size.

name: DecDCTvlc2
evidence: LIBPRESS VLC_C decoder; debug_source.c:244 calls (frame, buffer, table); callers pass the table built by MdecDiag_ExpandDecoderTable.

name: g_MdecResetBadOptionFormat
evidence: String "MDEC_reset:bad option(%d)\n" passed to printf in the default case of MdecDiag_Reset (decdct.c:138).

name: g_MdecInSyncName
evidence: String "MDEC_in_sync", the message argument of the input wait (mdec_wait.c:8).

name: g_MdecOutSyncName
evidence: String "MDEC_out_sync", the message argument of the output wait (mdec_wait.c:14).

name: g_MdecTimeoutFormat
evidence: String "%s timeout:\n" printed by MdecDiag_HandleTimeout (mdec_status.c:10).

name: g_MdecVlcTableSource
evidence: Compressed token stream read by MdecDiag_ExpandDecoderTable (vlc_build.c:7), which expands it into the VLC decoder table.

name: g_MdecQuantTableCommand
evidence: Holds 0x40000001, the MDEC set-quant-table command word, followed by the two 16-word tables; sent whole by DecDCTPutEnv/MdecDiag_Reset (decdct.c:60,127).

name: g_MdecQuantTableLuma
evidence: DecDCTPutEnv copies env->iqY (the first 64 bytes of DecDCTEnv) into it and DecDCTGetEnv copies it back out (decdct.c:40,49).

name: g_MdecQuantTableChroma
evidence: DecDCTPutEnv copies env->iqC into it and DecDCTGetEnv reads it back (decdct.c:41,55).

name: g_MdecScaleTableCommand
evidence: Holds 0x60000000, the MDEC set-scale-table command word; DecDCTPutEnv sends it with the table behind it (decdct.c:61).

name: g_MdecScaleTable
evidence: The 64 halfword DCT scale table (0x5A82 rows) following the command word; DecDCTGetEnv copies it to env->dct via D_8010DA90[1] (decdct.c:42).

name: g_MdecDma0MadrPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801080 (DMA0 MADR); MdecDiag_SendInput stores the buffer address through it (decdct.c:146).

name: g_MdecDma0BcrPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801084 (DMA0 BCR); MdecDiag_SendInput stores the block count/size word (decdct.c:147).

name: g_MdecDma0ChcrPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801088 (DMA0 CHCR); MdecDiag_SendInput starts the transfer with 0x01000201 (decdct.c:149).

name: g_MdecDma1MadrPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801090 (DMA1 MADR); MdecDiag_ReceiveOutput stores the destination (decdct.c:157).

name: g_MdecDma1BcrPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801094 (DMA1 BCR); MdecDiag_ReceiveOutput stores the size word (decdct.c:158).

name: g_MdecDma1ChcrPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801098 (DMA1 CHCR); MdecDiag_ReceiveOutput starts with 0x01000200 and the output wait polls bit 24 (decdct.c:159, mdec_wait.c:14).

name: g_MdecCommandRegPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801820 (MDEC command/parameter register); MdecDiag_SendInput writes the first command word through it (decdct.c:148).

name: g_MdecStatusRegPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F801824 (MDEC status/control); written with 0x80000000 (reset) and 0x60000000 (enable DMA) in MdecDiag_Reset and polled by the input wait.

name: g_MdecDmaControlRegPtr
evidence: Holds 0x1F8010F0 (DPCR); MdecDiag_SendInput/ReceiveOutput OR 0x88 into it to enable DMA0 and DMA1 (decdct.c:145,155).

name: g_MdecVlcPrimaryTable
evidence: DecDCTvlc indexes it with the top 13 bits of the bit window in 8-byte entries (vlc.c at .L8010C6E0); falls back to the secondary table when the entry word is 0.

name: g_MdecVlcSecondaryTable
evidence: DecDCTvlc indexes it with the top 9 bits in 4-byte entries when the primary entry is empty (vlc.c at .L8010C720).

name: g_MdecVlcSizeLimit
evidence: Initial 0x00FFFFFF; DecDCTvlcSize stores size*2 (or the default) here and returns the old value, DecDCTvlc doubles it into the output end pointer (vlc.c:20-44).

name: g_MdecVlcSavedState
evidence: DecDCTvlc stores a0,a1,v0,v1,t4,t5,t7,t8,t9 (9 words) here when the output limit is reached and reloads them when called with a0 == 0 (vlc.c:41-52, .L8010C82C).

name: g_MdecVlcFrameEnd
evidence: DecDCTvlc stores the frame end pointer (output base + header length*4 + 4) here and pads the output with 0xFE00 up to it at the end marker (vlc.c at .L8010C7E8).

name: g_MdecVlc2SizeLimit
evidence: Size-limit word of the VLC_C object, the DecDCTvlcSize2/DecDCTvlc2 twin of g_MdecVlcSizeLimit (vlc_c.c:20-36).

name: g_MdecVlc2SavedState
evidence: Resume state of DecDCTvlc2, same 9-word layout as g_MdecVlcSavedState (vlc_c.c:42,262).

name: g_MdecVlc2FrameEnd
evidence: Frame end pointer of DecDCTvlc2, same role as g_MdecVlcFrameEnd (vlc_c.c:82,241).

name: BootDisplay_InitDisplayResources
evidence: Defined under that name in boot_display/sprites.c; the sprite callback table (D_80125B4C slot init) and asm still used the address name.

name: BootDisplay_SelectFrameBuffers
evidence: Defined under that name in sprites.c; step slot of the sprite callback table.

name: BootDisplay_DisplayNoOp
evidence: Defined under that name in sprites.c (empty body); shutdown slot of the sprite callback table.

name: BootDisplay_StepImageSprite
evidence: Defined under that name in sprites.c; text slot of the sprite callback table.

name: BootDisplay_QueueTintedSprite
evidence: Defined under that name in sprites.c; glyph slot (s16 x, s16 y, u8 character) of the sprite callback table.

name: BootDisplay_InitDisplayBuffers
evidence: Defined under that name in boot_display/image_display.c; init slot of the image callback table.

name: BootDisplay_PresentFrame
evidence: Defined under that name in image_display.c; present slot of the image callback table.

name: BootDisplay_BrightenGlyph
evidence: Defined under that name in image_display.c; glyph slot of the image callback table.

name: BootDisplay_SetImageDisplay
evidence: Defined under that name in image_display.c; BootDisplay_InitDisplayBuffers calls it for buffer 0 and 1.

name: BootDisplay_StepImageDisplay
evidence: Defined under that name in image_display.c; text slot of the image callback table.

name: BootDisplay_CallInitSystem
evidence: Defined under that name in image_display.c; shutdown slot of the image callback table.

name: BootDisplay_BrightenImageRegion
evidence: Defined under that name in image_display.c; transition slot of the image callback table.

name: BootDisplay_WaitForCdAndRestoreCallbacks
evidence: Defined under that name in boot_display/playback_stop.c; BootDisplay_RunDisplay calls it after the loop (text_screen.c:62).

name: BootDisplay_StartPlayback
evidence: Defined under that name in playback.c; BootDisplay_RunDisplay calls it right after the playback file init.

name: BootDisplay_SetCdFilter
evidence: Defined under that name in playback.c and already in the overlay symbol file; text_screen.c still called the address name.

name: BootDisplay_QueueFadeSprite
evidence: Transition slot of the sprite callback table: BootDisplay_RunDisplay calls transition(fade) with a ramp 0..255 and back (text_screen.c cases 1-3); the function queues a semi-transparent sprite whose r/g/b are that argument (sprites.c:253).

name: BootDisplay_PresentSpriteFrame
evidence: Present slot of the sprite callback table: DrawSync, VSync(2), ResetGraph, PutDispEnv, DrawOTagEnv and flip g_ActiveDrawSlot (sprites.c:276); the image table's present slot is BootDisplay_PresentFrame.

name: BootDisplay_IssuePlaybackRead
evidence: Converts g_BootDisplayPlaybackStartPos to a CD position and sends DsPacket(mode 200, com 27 = CdlReadS), sets the current position and counts the request (playback.c:55); called by BootDisplay_StartPlayback and by BootDisplay_CheckPlaybackTime when the position fell 300 sectors behind.

name: g_BootDisplaySpriteCallbacks
evidence: BootDisplayCallbacks table whose slots are the sprites.c functions (init InitDisplayResources, step SelectFrameBuffers, text StepImageSprite, glyph QueueTintedSprite, transition, present, shutdown); BootDisplay_RunDisplay selects it when g_GameStateFlags & 0x10000 is clear (text_screen.c:7).

name: g_BootDisplayImageCallbacks
evidence: BootDisplayCallbacks table whose slots are the image_display.c functions; selected when g_GameStateFlags & 0x10000 is set (text_screen.c:5).

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackFilePath
evidence: Pointer to the XA stream path (D_80120D04, asset[71] start); BootDisplay_InitPlaybackFile passes it to DsSearchFile (playback_file.c:21).

name: g_BootDisplayCreditLines
evidence: Pointer array of credit text lines ended by a line starting 0xFF; BootDisplay_DrawTextBlock walks it (text_screen.c:78) and the overlay symbol file calls it the staff lines.

name: g_BootDisplayCreditImages
evidence: 30 pointers to the credit image chunks (D_8012E86C..D_8016F150) indexed by g_BootDisplayStateTimer and fed to DecDCTvlc2 (image_display.c:233, sprites.c:119).

name: g_BootDisplayFontTim
evidence: TIM loaded by Asset_LoadTimImage in BootDisplay_InitDisplayResources; g_BootDisplayTPage, g_BootDisplayClut and the glyph pixels come from it (sprites.c:27-37, image_display.c:51-58).

name: g_BootDisplayFontImageRect
evidence: Asset_GetTimImageRect(g_BootDisplayFontTim); its x/y feed GetTPage (sprites.c:35).

name: g_BootDisplayFontClutRect
evidence: Asset_GetTimClutRect(g_BootDisplayFontTim); its x/y feed GetClut (sprites.c:36).

name: g_BootDisplayFontImagePixels
evidence: Image pixels of the font TIM; BootDisplay_BrightenGlyph indexes it by glyph (image_display.c:95).

name: g_BootDisplayFontClutPixels
evidence: CLUT pixels of the font TIM; BRIGHTEN_NIBBLE reads the palette entry to get the brightness (image_display.c:81).

name: g_BootDisplayImageBrightness
evidence: Becomes r0/g0/b0 of the image sprite and is ramped by 4 within 0..128 according to g_BootDisplayTransition (sprites.c:90-108).

name: g_BootDisplayDone
evidence: Loop exit flag of BootDisplay_RunDisplay: cleared before the loop, set in state 4, the do-while ends when it is non-zero (text_screen.c:23,57,72).

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackEnded
evidence: Set to 1 by BootDisplay_CheckPlaybackTime once the stream position passed the end (playback.c:96); RunDisplay waits for it before accepting input (text_screen.c:36).

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackStartPos
evidence: Holds DsPosToInt of the XA file position (playback_file.c:29); BootDisplay_IssuePlaybackRead reads it back as the seek target and CheckPlaybackTime compares against it - 300.

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackEndPos
evidence: Start position plus size >> 11 (playback_file.c:30); CheckPlaybackTime ends playback when the current position exceeds it.

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackCurrentPos
evidence: Starts as the start position and is updated by the read command and by BootDisplay_RecordReadPosition; CheckPlaybackTime compares it with the end and start positions.

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackReadCount
evidence: Zeroed in BootDisplay_InitPlaybackFile and incremented once per CdlReadS issued by BootDisplay_IssuePlaybackRead.

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackRingIndex
evidence: Sector ring index 0..7 advanced in BootDisplay_StepPlaybackTransfer; selects the 2048-byte slot DsGetSector fills (playback.c:80-83).

name: g_BootDisplayReportedPos
evidence: DsPosToInt of the absolute position in the GetlocP report, stored by BootDisplay_RecordReadPosition and copied to the current position when non-zero (playback.c:104-108).

name: g_BootDisplayPlaybackSectorBuffer
evidence: Base of the 8-slot sector ring (g_CdLoadAreaBase + asset offset + 0x34800, playback_file.c:34); StepPlaybackTransfer passes slot*2048 to DsGetSector.
